edges: The Tupolev Tu-12 was shown at the Tushino Aviation Day Display.
The Tupolev Tu-12 underwent State acceptance trials.
The Tupolev Tu-12 was developed from the Tupolev Tu-2.
The Tupolev Tu-12 engaged in trials with the MiG-9.
The Tupolev Tu-12 engaged in trials with the Yak-23.
The Tupolev Tu-12 was operated by the Soviet Air Force.
